In this work, we take a human-centered approach to discover and measure language-based cultural norms, and cultural competence of LLMs.

We operationalise these features with a suite of computational metrics and use them for (a) surfacing latent cultural norms in human-written research papers at scale; and (b) highlighting the lack of cultural competence of LLMs, and their tendency to homogenise writing.
Improving cultural competence of language technologies is important.
